startingPoint: Limited resources, no investments, little spare money; I can spend 15 minutes today reviewing my accounts. No current net worth number is known.

waypoints.title: Account balances mapped
waypoints.rationale: Knowing the exact baseline across available accounts anchors all subsequent planning.
waypoints.completionCriteria: List every available bank account and current balance without opening new accounts.

waypoints.title: Essential monthly costs established
waypoints.rationale: Clear visibility into fixed expenses isolates what is actually available.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Calculate total essential monthly living expenses from recent records.

waypoints.title: Affordable contribution identified
waypoints.rationale: A sustainable contribution relies strictly on known surplus rather than assumptions.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Determine a specific, repeatable weekly or monthly amount that fits current reality.

waypoints.title: First deliberate allocation executed
waypoints.rationale: Moving from planning to consistent action builds the required habit.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Complete one planned transfer or debt payment using the identified affordable contribution.

suggestedOneMove.title: Review checking and savings balances
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Spending fifteen minutes reviewing current accounts establishes the baseline reality needed for the first waypoint.

proposal.guidance: Start by mapping what exists right now without assuming any external funding or new accounts.

waypoints.title: Identify one accessible account balance
waypoints.rationale: Starting with one account reduces effort and fits limited time today

requirements.title: Access at least one existing bank account

waypoints.completionCriteria: List the current balance of one accessible bank account without opening new accounts

waypoints.title: Essential monthly costs established
waypoints.rationale: Knowing essential expenses helps plan affordable contributions

waypoints.title: Affordable contribution identified
waypoints.rationale: Determining a manageable contribution amount fits current financial reality

requirements.title: Decide on a sustainable contribution amount
